meta.source: OpenRush inspect_keyword (live SERP + keyword volume). 14 calls, ~70 credits. Credits ran out (HTTP 402) before the 2 long-tail lookups, so those are not included.
meta.difficulty_note: difficulty_derived is derived from top-10 SERP domains, not a Google KD. OpenRush 'competition_level' is paid-ad competition and was NOT used for difficulty.
meta.volume_note: monthly_volume_us is the tool's current monthly figure. Trend data ends Aug 2026 (latest month available), so seasonal keywords may already be higher now.

keywords.trend_direction: seasonal, rising year over year; peaks Oct-Dec (Nov 2025: 33,100; Oct 2025: 27,100; Dec 2025: 27,100), trough Jun (9,900); Aug 2026 18,100 vs Aug 2025 18,100, Jul 2026 22,200 vs 12,100
keywords.intent: transactional (tool label); SERP mixes how-to guides, brand blogs and product pages
keywords.difficulty_reason: Top 7 seen: tiktok.com, madison-reed.com, garnierusa.com, instagram.com, xmondohair.com, youtube.com, walmart.com. Brand/retailer blogs and social, no Allure/Vogue-type editorial in the top 7.
keywords.recommended_angle: Cherry Cola Hair Color: 7 Shades, Who Suits Each One, and How to Keep It From Fading
keywords.notes: Peak window is now through Dec, so publish immediately. Brand blogs rank because the SERP rewards how-to depth; a shade-by-skin-tone and maintenance guide can compete. Evergreen enough to refresh each fall.

keywords.notes: Biggest volume on the list. Currently past the summer spike but the baseline is elevated; the head term is contested, so target a specific angle (fine hair, wavy, with bangs, fall styling). Tool's competition_level was LOW, but that is ad competition.

keywords.trend_direction: strongly seasonal; peaks Oct-Nov (Nov 2025: 9,900; Oct 2025: 9,900; Sep 2025: 8,100), near zero Mar-Jul. Latest data point Aug 2026: 2,900 (Sep-Oct 2026 not yet in data)
keywords.difficulty_reason: Top 6 seen: facebook.com, reddit.com, shopping.yahoo.com, pinterest.com, dailycharme.com, se.pinterest.com. Social, Reddit, a small brand shop and Pinterest; no major beauty publisher in the top 6.
keywords.recommended_angle: Fall Cat Eye Nails: 15 Autumn Shades (Plus an Easy At-Home Magnetic Polish Tutorial)
keywords.notes: Easiest SERP on the list, but the season is short: last year's volume peaked in Oct-Nov, so publish this week. Expect volume to be higher than the 2,900 shown. AI overview is present, so lead with original photos and a how-to.
